name: gamenet_send_pkt13_effect_anim_activation_record
description: GameNet::SendPkt13_EffectAnimActivationRecord sends a reliable packet containing the packed prefix of one zEffect activation record unless the pkt13 replay guard is active.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet/zEffect network packet source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x434370 validates the g_GameNetSuppressPkt13ActivationEcho early return, packed-size query, allocation of packedRecordSize+8 bytes, zero-fill of the full packet, packet type 0x13, packet size, local player key, copying only packedRecordSize bytes from the activation record after the 8-byte zNetwork header, reliable send, and free.
The native pkt13 send smoke verifies reliable send flags, packet type/size/local key, commandType-2 packed payload size 0x48, payload bytes, and replay-guard suppression.
